Name: Beth-aven
Description: A place near Bethel, named in the wilderness description of Benjamin's border and in the story of Joshua's ambush at Ai. Hosea later uses Beth-aven, house of vanity, as a name for Bethel after its idolatry.
BiblicalSignificance: Beth-aven is both a border town near Bethel and Hosea's rebuke-name for Bethel itself.
